title: Support
intro: Install GrantTap → connect an execution computer with GrantTap MCP → open your Task. This guide explains account passkeys, direct pairing, Mac access, connection modes and recovery.

sections.heading: Account passkey and QR
paragraphs: An Account Mesh exists as soon as you create or sign in to your Personal account, even with no computer. It can contain many Projects and their Meshes. Use the same passkey in GrantTap MCP to add a computer. Every linked computer running MCP contributes its own Task catalog to the account; each Task keeps its computer route. On a trusted iPhone, Devices → Add another iPhone or iPad offers a five-minute, one-use Account Mesh QR for a new device. It creates a separate session and discovers all linked MCP computers, including computers added later.

The same screen can request a QR for one computer. A Project Mesh invite has its own role and permissions; it does not open the whole account. A GrantTap passkey is not Sign in with Apple. Apple Passwords can sync it through iCloud if you save it there.

On a Mac with the local GrantTap bridge, granttap.com/connect can request a fresh passkey assertion to approve one coding-app connection. The Mac must still authorize its local MCP bridge. You can review and revoke account devices in the account page.

sections.heading: Mac app and device connections
bullets: Open Help → GrantTap Help for built-in guides. GrantTap → About GrantTap shows the version, purchase options, Terms, Privacy and licenses. These documents remain readable offline.
In the Mac app, open Devices → Connect iPhone or iPad for a one-time QR. On the phone or tablet, open Devices → Add a device (Scan QR).
To add a Mac or PC, choose Connect a computer by link and paste its one-time invitation. Existing device connections are preserved.
Install MCP on each computer that runs coding agents. A Mac used only to manage linked computers does not need a local MCP. Local Mac control additionally requires approved local access.

sections.heading: Purchase, restore and connection modes
paragraphs: Planned US launch prices: Personal: $3.99 per month — up to 2 computers; Personal Plus: $6.99 per month — up to 5 computers; Fleet: $11.99 per month — up to 15 computers. Mac Local: $39.99 once. Apple’s purchase sheet controls availability, local pricing and any eligible trial. Models and AI tokens are separate.
Use Restore purchases in Settings with the same Apple Account that made the purchase. Manage subscription opens Apple's controls. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.

Active Personal includes linked Mac managed access; no additional Mac Local purchase is required for that path. Mac Local opens local control and your own relay without a Personal subscription. Managed hosting is not part of the one-time purchase.

sections.heading: Connect a computer
bullets: Install Node.js 22 or newer.
Run npm install -g granttap-mcp.
Run granttap setup. It detects providers, installs supported hooks, and starts or repairs the helper.
Open the GrantTap connection card in the coding app and choose Add a device. Scan its one-time QR in GrantTap on iPhone.
Use Add another device for a second phone or Reconnect for the same phone. granttap.com/connect handles coding-app approval and observations, not the QR.
Use granttap status for a read-only readiness summary.

sections.heading: Provider readiness
bullets: Claude Code and Codex are the primary integrations.
Codex may require you to trust the exact GrantTap hooks before restarting Codex.
For Cursor, install the GrantTap Marketplace listing, then run granttap setup. Its supported controls are described in the Cursor guide. Do not add GrantTap in Customize → MCPs.
Grok Build controls depend on what the installed local runtime exposes.
Cursor Cloud · fetch failed is a leftover user HTTP MCP at 127.0.0.1:17342, or the unused cloud plugin source — not proof the phone is unpaired.
A provider that is not installed is not an error.

sections.heading: Pairing or delivery does not work
bullets: Check the task computer is awake, its MCP is running and the expected account or direct pairing is selected. Run granttap status before changing pairings.
Confirm internet access and use a wss:// relay URL.
A website “seen” or account Online label confirms registration, not chat delivery. Chats are available after the phone has a secure link and receives that computer’s Task catalog.
The Account Mesh combines Tasks from all linked MCP computers. Reconnect repairs the affected computer link; it does not switch all chats to a default computer.
Check iOS Notifications and Background App Refresh. APNs timing is controlled by Apple and cannot be guaranteed.
Never send pairing tokens, room credentials, provider credentials, prompts, or repository paths in support messages.

sections.heading: Choosing managed, direct or own relay
paragraphs: Managed mode uses GrantTap delivery and an active Personal entitlement on the same account. A linked Mac can act as a managed client without a separate Mac Local purchase. Only computers enabled to publish agent work use the plan’s computer allowance.

Mac Local is the separate one-time right for local Mac control and your own relay. Direct mode uses encrypted endpoint discovery; your own relay uses your endpoint. Neither mode makes a private computer reachable through NAT automatically. Supply a reachable TLS endpoint or a suitable VPN and maintain your server, updates and backups.

Push requires a working push service and Apple permissions. A custom relay address alone does not configure APNs or guarantee background delivery. Keep tokens and private endpoints out of support screenshots.

sections.heading: A second iPhone or iPad
paragraphs: For your own linked clients, open Devices on a trusted signed-in device and choose Add another iPhone or iPad. Scan the account invitation on the new device before its displayed expiry. The new device gets its own revocable account session and discovers account computers.

A QR for one computer is a different operation. On Mac use Devices → Connect iPhone or iPad, then on the phone Devices → Add a device (Scan QR). For an existing device use Reconnect; do not create a new pairing as a routine repair.
Inviting another person to a Project Mesh grants the selected role and project access. It does not share your whole account, provider subscription, source-hosting credentials or Mac Local license.

sections.heading: Models, Effort and Usage
paragraphs: Open the model control beside the composer. Select the provider-reported model and, when supported, its Effort level. These settings apply to the next message sent from GrantTap; unsupported levels are not added to a provider.

Subscription limits and reset times come from the provider account. Token and tool statistics are separate observed execution data in Usage. Missing or stale information is marked unknown; GrantTap is not the provider’s invoice. Your AI accounts and model charges remain separate.

sections.heading: Sending, queueing and scheduled work
paragraphs: Open the intended Task and check its computer and provider before sending. Its route stays with that Task. A different active computer in Devices does not silently move an existing chat.

After the encrypted upload is confirmed, the relay can retain a queued request until its due time or expiry and deliver it when the target computer reconnects, even if the phone is closed. Before that confirmation, keep GrantTap connected so the local pending upload can finish. Queue limits, expiry, revocation and available provider operations still apply.

Use Queue to inspect, change the supported delivery time or cancel a waiting request. Retry acts on failed delivery; it is not proof the agent completed the work. If an acknowledgement is uncertain, inspect the Task before creating another copy of the same request.

sections.heading: Stopping work and attachments
paragraphs: Stop is available for a provider-reported active execution that supports interruption. Closing the chat or locking a device does not stop the agent. Waiting messages have their own queue controls.

Keep the app connected until an attachment upload is confirmed. If a picture shows Retry, reopen it while the task computer and the authorized connection are available. A file preview requires workspace access on that Task’s computer. An edit request sent from GrantTap is applied through the supported computer/provider path; it is not an unconditional local overwrite.

sections.heading: Health and Graph
paragraphs: Repository analysis runs on the execution computer and requires the installed GrantTap Engine. Keep both Apple clients and GrantTap MCP current; MCP 0.8.68 or newer supplies the repository and architecture contract used by recent clients.

In Mesh → Health, check the computer, repository binding and timestamp. Refresh requests new evidence; a cached snapshot is not a live connection. If a repository was moved or its remote changed, review that binding instead of deleting all pairings.

A graph can be incomplete when analysis is bounded or a language is unsupported. The plan does not turn missing evidence into a complete architecture report. Send sanitized error codes and versions to Support if a current report still fails.

sections.heading: Purchases confirmed but access not active
paragraphs: Do not buy a second time after Apple confirms a purchase. Reconnect to the same GrantTap account, check internet access and use Restore purchases to retry verified purchase and account synchronization. Support can investigate a persistent activation error without your Apple password or payment-card details.

An Apple billing account and a GrantTap passkey account have different roles. Use the purchasing Apple Account for restoration and the intended GrantTap account for shared managed access. Ending Personal does not delete downloaded chats or revoke a purchased Mac Local license.

sections.heading: Apple Watch
paragraphs: Install the companion through the paired iPhone. Watch displays synchronized work and sends supported quick decisions through that phone. It is not an independent coding computer or a separate paid plan.

Check the iPhone’s connection and Apple notification permissions first. APNs and Watch background timing are controlled by Apple. Decisions still require the request to be current and allowed by project and computer policy.

sections.heading: Approvals and safe access
paragraphs: Task controls apply only to supported actions and the stated execution. A global capability deny still wins over task preferences and auto-accept. Full-access wording does not grant rights to another user’s computer or repository.

Never share a live QR, passkey recovery material, provider tokens or pairing credentials. Remove a lost device through the account/device controls. Forgetting a device and cancelling a subscription are different actions.

sections.heading: Choose managed publishing computers
paragraphs: Open Subscription → Managed computers in the Apple app, or the Computers section of your GrantTap account on the website. Sign in with the same passkey. Turn publishing off to free a managed place without deleting the computer, its pairing or downloaded history. Heartbeats do not re-enable that choice; use the publishing control to enable the computer again. Previously issued relay access can last up to five minutes before expiring.

sections.heading: Version history
paragraphs: The iPhone, iPad and Mac apps are available by TestFlight invitation. Find the build number in About. The computer MCP updates separately.
bullets: Apps 202 · TestFlight · October 18, 2026. Messages and queues in a new chat save to the relay before the computer opens its task. Chat ID changes and repeated Send now preserve delivery state. Update the computer MCP to 0.8.75 for this behavior.

MCP 0.8.75. Queued follow-ups wait for the original task and continue that chat after the computer returns. Controller, provider and Project checks remain in place; repeated delivery does not create a second task.

Apps 201 · TestFlight · October 18, 2026. Full beta access without buying a subscription. Approvals and messages confirm relay storage without waiting for the computer. New queue uploads do not wait behind older receipt requests. Adaptive chat for iPhone Duo, rotation and the keyboard.

Apps 199 · TestFlight · October 17, 2026. Transfer offers Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build models and reasoning effort. Claude or Codex cloud transfers run through the source computer with MCP 0.8.72. Fixed repeated reconnections after relay admission is refused.

MCP 0.8.74. Cursor questions, answer choices and visible warnings reach GrantTap. Retained Cursor chats open without waiting for the working-tree check. Transfer preparation supports committing changes before handing off a task.

sections.heading: What counts as a computer?
paragraphs: One stable computer enabled to publish agent work through the managed service. Multiple agents and projects on it do not use extra seats. iPhone, iPad, Watch and controller-only Macs do not add execution-computer seats.

sections.heading: Do I need Personal and Mac Local?
paragraphs: Not for managed mode. Active Personal provides managed access to your linked Mac. Mac Local is the separate one-time purchase for local control and your own relay.

sections.heading: Are AI models and tokens included?
paragraphs: No. You use your own provider accounts and plans. GrantTap manages supported executions; it does not replace a model subscription.

sections.heading: What remains after cancellation?
paragraphs: Paid access continues until the stated date unless the entitlement is separately revoked. Downloaded local history, chats and images are not deleted. A purchased Mac Local license remains valid.

sections.heading: Is Fleet a team plan?
paragraphs: Fleet increases your managed-computer allowance. It is not an enterprise package, an SLA or a fifteen-person license. Supported Project Mesh collaboration remains available.

sections.heading: Do I pay separately for Apple Watch?
paragraphs: No. Supported Watch actions work through your paired iPhone. The watch is not a standalone execution computer.

sections.heading: Contact and diagnostics
paragraphs: Email sergii.ziborov@gmail.com with app, iOS/watchOS, Node.js, helper, and provider versions plus sanitized reproduction steps. Export diagnostics from the app's Troubleshooting destination when available.
